article.title: Four underrated European masterworks
article.excerpt: 1. The Ravenna mosaics, most of all at St. Vitale . 2. Monreale, the Norman church outside of Palermo, Sicily . 3. Matthias Grünewald’s Isenheim altar , in Colmar, France. 4. Tiepolo’s paintings in the Residenz , in Wurzburg. I much prefer any of those to the Mona Lisa, and to my prejudiced taste they are all among the very greatest of artistic masterpieces.

article.title: Is Paris the best place to eat in France?
article.excerpt: I have been to France many times, but I have mixed feelings about so much eating in Paris. Yes so many items are wonderful but could not UNESCO have a few branches in Colmar, Avignon, or the Southwest?
